entries.what: Pinecone Assistant's SSE MCP endpoint, /mcp/assistants/<name>/sse, stopped working.

source.quote: After August 31, 2025 at 11:59:59 PM UTC, the SSE-based MCP endpoint for assistants (/mcp/assistants/<YOUR_ASSISTANT_NAME>/sse) will no longer work.

lookFor: A Pinecone Assistant MCP URL ending in /sse. The same URL without /sse is the live one.
entries.replacement: The streamable HTTP transport MCP endpoint, /mcp/assistants/<YOUR_ASSISTANT_NAME>.
requires: Move the client to the streamable HTTP MCP transport as well as the URL: an SSE client class does not speak to the new endpoint.
